items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I tell you who was in the band - Metcalf... Yeah, was in the band. We worked in the - and I remember the place where we worked.

ctx.x: for Boston - you see, when I left Boston, I stayed in Boston 4 or 5 years, maybe a little bit longer, see. Then I came from Boston to Philadelphia. Well, this - now here's, there's something else I remember in Philadelphia. See, now this is something else I remember in Philadelphia. I tell you who was in the band, but I still can't remember the name of the band or the leader. But I tell you who was in the band - Metcalf -
